decisions.note: Skill ID 911191 is verified as JP 夢寐に見る銀世界, the same poetic title concept encountered in term-0051. Keep it deferred consistently until a stable Vietnamese wording is established.

decisions.target_vi: Người tiên phong của giấc mơ
decisions.note: Skill ID 410041 verifies JP 夢の先駆者; the Vietnamese title directly preserves the verified Japanese construction.
Skill ID 210342 is verified as JP 夢の再生方法. The Chinese source shortens the Japanese title and does not preserve 方法, so a canonical Vietnamese title should not be fixed from the Chinese wording alone.

Skill ID 210072 is verified as JP 夢の途中. Depending on context this compact title can mean being midway through a dream or on the path toward one; repository evidence does not resolve the preferred Vietnamese phrasing.

The assigned source is a stylized skill title, but a reliable Japanese alias for skill ID 103503211 was not established from the available evidence. Defer rather than canonize the Chinese localization wording.

Skill ID 202501 is verified as JP 遮二無二. The Chinese localization uses a different idiom, while the Japanese expression has several plausible Vietnamese equivalents; defer for terminology harmonization.

Skill ID 120411 is verified as JP 桜吹雪くスプリントバースト. The title mixes poetic Japanese with the loan phrase Sprint Burst, and no repository convention establishes a stable Vietnamese/Latin treatment for the whole title.
Skill ID 110411 verifies JP CHERRY☆スクランブル. Preserve CHERRY and ☆ exactly and romanize the clear katakana loan スクランブル as Scramble instead of following the Chinese semantic substitution.

Skill ID 107601111 is verified as JP 桜前線進行中！. 桜前線 is the established Japanese 'cherry blossom front' expression, and several Vietnamese renderings are possible; defer rather than flatten its wordplay.
Skill ID 106902111 is verified as JP 桜花爛漫一直線. The compact poetic compound has multiple natural Vietnamese title renderings and no repository precedent selects one.

Skill ID 106401221 is verified as JP テンアゲスタイル. This is slangy/stylized Japanese loan-word phrasing, while the Chinese source is a semantic rewrite; the stable Vietnamese title style is not established.
A reliable Japanese alias for skill ID 105501111 was not established from the available evidence, and the source is clearly stylized. Defer instead of canonizing a Chinese-localized title.
